text: スタンプが　いっぱい　なので　もう　おせません！

structure.jp: スタンプが　いっぱい　なので

patterns.name: 〜ので
patterns.explanation: ので gives the reason for what follows. いっぱい　なので = 'because it is full'.

patterns.name: 〜れる (potential)
patterns.explanation: The え-sound form of a verb says can do it; with ません it says can't. おせません = 'can't press'.
